activity.notes: Trimble was re-elected First Minister in November 2001. This second Activity ends with the suspension of devolved institutions in October 2002 and is kept separate from his earlier term.

sources.title: Northern Ireland Assembly Chronology
sources.citation_text: The Assembly chronology records Trimble's re-election as First Minister on 6 November 2001 and the subsequent institutional chronology leading to the October 2002 suspension.
